title: Wire Protocol Framing Incompatibility: Custom Type/Response framing vs Standard JSON-RPC 2.0
impact: Projected migration failure: if the BB provider connects directly to the latest durable-zero runner, all requests fail. The runner server expects JSON-RPC 2.0 frames with method names (rejecting custom type-based commands as -32600 Invalid Request), while the provider RunnerRpcChannel drops JSON-RPC responses because msg.type is undefined.
fixDecision: fix-now (migrate provider RunnerRpcChannel to standard JSON-RPC 2.0)

title: Runner Readiness Handshake Seam Mismatch
evidence: bb-plugin-provider-pi-durable/src/host/session.ts:44-50 (waitForReady blocks on legacy ready frame) vs durable-zero/packages/runner/src/composition.ts:144-180 (starts StdioJsonRpcServer immediately without emitting legacy custom frame)
impact: Projected migration failure: provider PiThreadSession.start() blocks on readyPromise for 15,000ms until timeout unless adapted. The modern runner is ready immediately upon process launch. Provider should probe readiness via standard public session/getState request rather than expecting a custom frame.
fixDecision: fix-now (provider probes readiness via public session/getState over JSON-RPC)

title: Split-Brain Runner Asset Discovery: Obsolete core/dist/runner.js vs packages/runner/dist/main.js
evidence: bb-plugin-provider-pi-durable/scripts/copy-runner-assets.mjs:7-14 and src/host/runner-lookup.ts:32-38 vs durable-zero/scripts/build.mjs:42-59 and durable-zero/package.json:exports
impact: Provider packaging and runtime runner discovery search legacy core/dist/runner.js instead of packages/runner/dist/main.js (or index.js). In fresh builds, runner assets will either be missing or stale.
fixDecision: fix-now (update copy-runner-assets.mjs and runner-lookup.ts to search packages/runner/dist/main.js)

title: Host Reverse-Tool Continuation Seam Disconnected
evidence: bb-plugin-provider-pi-durable/src/extension/bb-tools-extension.ts:2 imports unexported forwardHostToolCall from 'durable-zero/core'; durable-zero/packages/runner/src/composition.ts:144-180 does not instantiate HostBridge
impact: Dynamic BB host tools (injected via PI_BB_TOOLS_FILE) fail to compile or route calls. The native IHostBridge implementation in runner/src/host/host-bridge.ts:33-85 is not wired into the composition root.
fixDecision: fix-now (instantiate owned HostBridge in composition.ts and inject into extension; do not restore global forwardHostToolCall/setHostToolForwarder)

title: Thread Fork Import Seam Broken: forkSessionDatabase Relocated
evidence: bb-plugin-provider-pi-durable/src/host/thread-fork.ts:3 imports forkSessionDatabase from 'durable-zero/core', but packages/core/src/index.ts does not export it (relocated to adapter-pi-durable/src/session-fork.ts)
impact: Projected migration failure: thread fork invocations will fail with named export not found if linked against the refactored source.
fixDecision: fix-now (update provider import in thread-fork.ts to 'durable-zero/adapter-pi-durable'; do not leak DB implementation into pure contracts)

title: Unmounted SessionDispatcher in Production Runner Bypasses Control Seams
evidence: durable-zero/packages/runner/src/composition.ts:147-177 mounts inline 6-method handler instead of createSessionDispatcher from packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts:25-170
impact: Runtime control methods (session/steer, session/compact, models/set, models/setThinking, session/abortTask) return -32601 Method Not Found when called on the production runner. Note: mounting dispatcher leaves binding/register, binding/list, session/fork, and tools/register typed UnsupportedCapabilityError.
fixDecision: fix-now (mount createSessionDispatcher in composition.ts and account for typed unsupported seams)

title: Subagent Policy RPC Payload Envelope Mismatch
evidence: durable-zero/packages/runner/src/composition.ts:166-168 passes raw params to coordinator.setSubagentPolicy vs packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts:70-74 (unwraps policyRecord ?? record ?? params) and packages/adapter-pi-durable/src/engine/subagent-policy-state.ts:30
impact: If provider sends { policyRecord: record } (its current wire shape in session.ts:101), direct composition handler fails schema validation in subagent-policy-state.ts because revision is expected at top level of the passed record.
fixDecision: fix-now (mount session-dispatcher to unwrap policyRecord ?? record ?? params)

title: Unused Legacy Engine Dependencies in Provider package.json
evidence: bb-plugin-provider-pi-durable/package.json (dependencies @earendil-works/chord, @earendil-works/pi-codemode, @earendil-works/pi-schema, proper-lockfile, quickjs-wasi are unreferenced in src/)
impact: Dependency hygiene smell and maintenance friction; enforces unnecessary version locks in tests/package-integrity.test.ts without runtime usage.
fixDecision: log-only (schedule cleanup in Phase 2 with test assertion updates)
